description: Indexed results return immediately; unknown mints use coalesced, bounded free-node discovery. max_wait_ms controls discovery wait (default 750, range 0–2000), excluding database/report time. Read lookup_status: pending, deferred or unavailable never establishes absence; first-buyer analysis remains under its background budget. The same checks as new_launches (authorities, Token-2022 extensions, liquidity and lock, price and market cap, creator history, first-buyer funding graph) for Solana token mints you already know about, in one call: up to 5 on Free, 50 when paid per call, or the plan's batch size (max_batch in /billing/plans). Each launch has section provenance and observation ages under data, plus a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Price: 0.015 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.
